target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — project Hays-local source pool lists O. filiformis. Travis — UT herbarium index records Gaura longiflora, an accepted synonym of O. filiformis. A third exact target-zone county was not locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical Gaura/Calylophus names are counted only after synonym reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the tall airy habit and gaura-type flowers. Longflower beeblossom is usually a robust winter annual, sometimes biennial, with white asymmetric flowers that fade pink and a long floral tube.
diagnostic_traits: usually robust winter annual, sometimes biennial

comparisons.key_distinctions: O. calcicola is perennial with a woody rootstock and limestone specialization; O. filiformis is usually annual/biennial and often much taller and airier.
